items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1960-03-16
items.q: Johnny Saint Seale was living up there at that time... he used to play a little combo right at the corner from his house... So he told me, he said, well you keep it up.

ctx.x: Yeah. I think it was a 28. And well I never did actually let me set in because I was kind of leery about setting in and you know in anybody's band or anything like that. So while we was living in Calton, Johnny Saint Seale was living up there at that time, well he used to play a little combo right at the corner from his house at Boydette and Hickory. He was living on Hickory between Boydette and Adams. Well he used to play there and he didn't have no drums handed so they had long benches and I used to have a pair…
Yes, he played with Faith Marable. Yeah, that's right, yeah, Faith Marable, yeah.
